title: Suggestion result
description: What the agent answers with: candidates, or the typed not-a-workspace verdict. NO PRICE, NO PRODUCT NAME AND NO IMAGE CROSSES - the application resolves those and recomputes every amount - and no band label is carried, because the application sorts the candidates by total and labels them by rank. It carries NO USAGE either: a model cannot observe a call count or a token count, so the run's cost follows the answer as a separate object - see run-usage.schema.json.

status.description: notWorkspace is a result, not an error: the application words it and does not report a failure.

reason.description: A one-line reason, present when status is notWorkspace.

options.description: Up to three genuinely different setups. Fewer is fewer - never padded with a near-duplicate to reach three. Empty when the verdict is notWorkspace.

lines.description: Which SKU goes in which slot, and how many. A slot the request said nothing about is left out.

rationale.description: The model's own words, purpose only. The application caps it and strips URLs, markup and currency amounts before a customer sees it.

slot.description: The slot this line fills. Kept in step with the request schema by a test, so every file stays self-contained and any consumer can validate one without a registry.

sku.description: Must exist in the catalogue the request carried; the application rejects the whole run otherwise.

quantity.description: Must not exceed the slot's capacity; the application rejects the whole run otherwise.

why.description: The model's own words for this line, purpose only. Capped and stripped like the rationale.
